name: Smith Machine Good Morning
steps: Stand under the Smith bar with it resting across your upper back and take an even grip.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart and release the hooks.
Soften your knees slightly, brace your abs firmly, and keep your spine completely neutral.
Push your hips back until you feel tension in your hamstrings and can still hold your back steady.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to drive your hips forward and stand smoothly back upright.
tips: Keep your head in line with your spine as your torso tips forward.
Keep the movement focused on pushing your hips back rather than bending deeply at your knees.
